SPECIAL ABILITIES: Armored Mage (ex) Normally, armor heavier than light armor interferes with a spell-caster gestures, which can cause spells to fail if those spells have a somatic component. A blood gigas's limited focus and specialized training, however, allows him to avoid spell failure so long as he sticks to medium armor or light armor.

Lifetap (su) Whenever the blood gigas casts spells that deal shadow damage to a living creature, he gains health back equal to spell level of the spell + 5. If this would put him above his normal hit points total just dissipates.

Magnitude 8 (su) Once every 1d4 rounds and must be within reach of the ground, a blood gigas can cause the ground to erupt wildly around it within a 60-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 15d10 points of earth damage and are inflicted with the weighted status effect for 1d8 rounds. They must make Reflex save (DC 31) to reduce the damage by half and negate the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 31).
Militant (ex) Blood Gigas are proficient with all simple and all martial weapons

curation.summary: Blood Gigas is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 56 generated item(s) across 9 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
